title: SQLite table created lazily on every request via get_db()
evidence: app.py:15-26 runs CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inside get_db() on each first-access rather than once at startup
suggestion: Optional: initialize schema once in create_app() to avoid re-issuing DDL per connection

title: year validation accepts booleans as integers
evidence: app.py:57 uses isinstance(data['year'], int), and isinstance(True, int) is True in Python, so {"year": true} passes validation
suggestion: Reject bool explicitly: isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)

title: isbn is not constrained to be unique
evidence: app.py:16-24 books table has no UNIQUE constraint on isbn; duplicate ISBNs are allowed
suggestion: Optional beyond spec: add a UNIQUE(isbn) constraint if ISBN should identify a book
